meta.source_title: Cronología de la ciencia ficción cubana contemporánea (1999-2025)
notes: Titles, years, publishers and page counts follow the Korad chronology.
Every entry in the main chronology is is_published = true; the 'Títulos en preparación' section is is_published = false.
Anthologies are typed 'anthology' and are linked to their included authors only when the source names them; the source lists anthology contents as 'Varios', so most anthologies have no author links.
Genre is 'ciencia-ficcion' by default; 'fantasia' is added only where the source itself labels the volume as fantasy.
editorial_id has been removed from works; editorial relationships live in the editorial_work junction table (supports co-editions).
is_published lives only on works (not on authors).
edition_number is optional; null unless a numbered edition is known.
One comic entry included: 'La historia de Zoe' (2016, Alejandro Rodríguez, tipo Historieta → comic).
